scope: Code and training-only migration preflight; approval to build training candidate artifacts, not to train or accept evaluation labels.

tests.name: training-only in-memory migration and provenance closure
transitive partition/source_group/parent_id/source_id closure in reversed input order
non-tool annotation rejects null/list tool_arguments and non-list missing_slots

resolved_findings: prepare_evaluation/freeze_evaluation validate frozen train code/policy/source/artifact hashes through validate_train.
freeze_evaluation independently repeats complete 384-ID, role, family, split, cohort and action/tool coverage validation.
validate checks evaluation manifest train_sha256 against actual training artifact.
build_train verifies semantic evidence source hashes and every source row hash, and asserts old 80 quarantined IDs are not released.
Tool arguments reject contradictions with explicit trusted state; all 728 argument-bearing migration survivors also have that trusted state.
Review identity must be a nonempty string distinct from the known evaluation author; annotation argument/slot container types are strict.
limitations: Did not open new or old evaluation author data, development/calibration/final files, model outputs or result reports. Test fixtures are local synthetic CPU objects.
No training artifacts were built by this reviewer. Build-train should be run by parent after this review; training_eligible remains false.
Machine screening covered 12235 training rows, but semantic reading covered only 336 selected rows; migration does not certify complete new-policy semantic correctness.
Overlap auditing is exact normalized text plus top20 trigram candidates with SequenceMatcher>=0.86, not exhaustive semantic deduplication.
Prompt uses a strict Qwen3.5 closed non-thinking prefix and single-token A-H/A-E candidates. No real tokenizer/model speed or quality was evaluated in this review.
New inputs explicitly assume no handoff connector/in-session handoff; true legacy handoff source groups are quarantined, not converted into availability.
